title: flow-analyzer (Cloudflare Worker) /health response
description:
Response contract for GET /health on the Cloudflare Worker defined by src/index.js and wrangler.jsonc (worker name: flow-analyzer).

NOTE: this repository contains a SECOND, unrelated /health endpoint — the FastAPI app in claude_openai_extension.py:124, which returns {"status":"healthy","services":{...}} and is covered by tests/integration/test_api_endpoints.py. The two services have different shapes by design; this schema describes only the Worker.

hyperdrive.description: True when the CHITTYOS_CORE_DB Hyperdrive binding is present.
